description: Save compatibility test matrix for DLC releases. Every row is a scenario that must pass before sign-off; the uninstall and rollback directions catch the corruption bugs players actually report.

scenarios.expected: Loads normally; no DLC content referenced
Loads; DLC content becomes accessible; progress preserved
Graceful handling: clear message or save marked incompatible; never crash or corrupt
Loads; all DLC progress and items present
Quest state restored exactly; quest items and flags intact
Save transfers between PC and console with DLC data intact
Save still loads; no phantom DLC references; no crash

scenarios.scenario: Rollback to pre-DLC save after uninstall
scenarios.expected: Rollback works; no leftover DLC quest entries or items

checklist: Base game saves load with DLC installed
Save without DLC does not corrupt with DLC installed
Save rollback works if DLC uninstalled
Cloud saves sync correctly with DLC data
Save file size increase within limits
No save data loss during DLC install/uninstall
